purpose: Single source of truth for the Nabaperks A4 fold-to-peak table-tent registry, copy, and geometry. A tent is one A4 sheet split into two equal faces; the top face prints rotated 180 degrees so a single mid-sheet fold stands both faces upright, one toward each side of the table. Copy is honest by contract: no fabricated stats, no invented testimonials, no free-stamp claims.
